description: Hash bounded byte messages with the six pinned Rust SHA-2 digest variants.

contract.operation: Hash the supplied byte string with the selected pinned SHA-2 digest variant.

4.initial_state: Pinned SHA-512/224 IV; not truncated SHA-512.

5.initial_state: Pinned SHA-512/256 IV; not truncated SHA-512.

contract.input_layout: [variant, message_length, message_bytes...], with each byte in 0..255
contract.padding: SHA-224/256 use 64-byte blocks and a 64-bit big-endian message bit length. SHA-384/512/512-t use 128-byte blocks and a 128-bit big-endian message bit length. Append 0x80, zero-pad to the length field, then append the bit length.
contract.output_encoding: Raw digest bytes in big-endian order, without header or text encoding.
contract.errors: Malformed framing, invalid variant, length, or message byte returns -1 before output checks. A valid digest with null or insufficient byte capacity returns -2 without writes.

input.encoding: [variant, message_length, message_bytes...]; bytes are integers 0 through 255

output.encoding: Raw SHA-2 digest bytes in big-endian order

workspace.meaning: Capacity for the largest SHA-512 digest output.
